summary: Add boolean marketing_opt_in to account_user via expand stage with NOT NULL DEFAULT false, optional backfill to guarantee no NULLs, then deploy new version with state_only migration, retire old version, and contract stage to lock in the default. Zero downtime with both versions live during overlap.
write_consistency: The old version, unaware of the new column, will INSERT rows that receive the column's database DEFAULT (false). The new version explicitly sets marketing_opt_in in its writes, ensuring consistent values. During overlap, reads see the most recently written value from either version, and the NOT NULL DEFAULT false prevents NULLs.

stages.description: Add required boolean column marketing_opt_in with NOT NULL and DEFAULT false.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN marketing_opt_in boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

stages.description: Backfill any existing rows where marketing_opt_in might be NULL to false (should be 0 rows after expand).
sql: UPDATE account_user SET marketing_opt_in = false WHERE marketing_opt_in IS NULL;

stages.description: Retire the old version; it will no longer serve traffic.
Set the column default explicitly to false for robustness after retire.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ALTER COLUMN marketing_opt_in SET DEFAULT false;
